doctor's gauge/handle accessory set against the car roof (not fastened in the booklet; recorded only to keep one connected model)

notes: The minifigure (head, hair, torso, legs) on pages 2 and 15 is not in the 62-piece parts list, so it is not recorded.

The booklet builds the car and then, in step 13, the doctor's hand-held gauge/handle accessory (b58-b60). The briefcase b61 is a loose prop. Neither is fastened to the car. To keep one connected graph I added two loose joins (b58-b61 and b58-b42). These are assumptions, not connections shown in the booklet.

Piece placement is inferred from small isometric drawings. The order of the rear sub-assembly (steps 5-6), the exact supports under the cupboards, the hood grille, the red doors' hinge points and the stickers are best guesses.
Wheels b45/b46 go on holder b4 and b47/b48 on holder b5, which is the wheel pairing the booklet implies.
Part counts match the parts list: 62 pieces in total.
